turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're planning a hike next Saturday and I have to choose the trail.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first trail is a flat loop around a lake, about five miles, with lots of shade.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a steep climb to a ridge with amazing views, but it's eight miles and pretty rocky.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a forest trail along a river with a few small waterfalls, moderate and six miles.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a coastal path that's easy but gets crowded on weekends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The river trail sounds like a great middle ground, waterfalls and a moderate distance. The ridge climb is the most rewarding if everyone is fit and has good shoes. The lake loop is best if anyone in the group is new to hiking.
